name: Ohinasama ~Shiawase wa Suigin no Aji~
original_name: オヒナサマ　~しあわせは水銀の味~
source:
The protagonist is a fatigued, out-of-work NEET dependent.
By chance he meets a young girl and inexplicable phenomena occur...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ076082.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一个疲惫不堪、没有工作、依赖他人生活的家里蹲。
一次偶然中，他遇见一名年轻女孩，随后发生了无法解释的现象…

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/home/work/=/product_id/RJ076082.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
